notes: Order of `characters` is a contract: the relay picks slugs[fnv1a64(project_id) % n]. Append only.
`ready: false` means the art is a placeholder and the files may not exist yet.
SVG/PNG: 64x64 viewBox, black #000 disc with a 2 px white #fff ring, white tree, black face; transparent outside the disc.
Lottie: 60 fps, shapes only, no expressions, no raster, no masks; `idle` and `working` loop seamlessly, `reply` plays once.
Frame strips: horizontal row of square frames sampled from the Lottie at 30 fps; `1x` = 28 px, `2x` = 56 px, `rail` = 72 px, `rail@2x` = 144 px; transparent outside the disc.

Tree strips (`frames[state].tree`): same frames, only the tree on transparent, drawn in grey LEVELS (tree 255, tree_light 220, tree_dark 170, face 0) so the app can map level -> hue at draw time; it draws the black disc + ring itself.

Colors: the tree carries the color on a neutral black disc. `tree` = canopy, `tree_dark` = trunk/shade, `tree_light` = highlight, `face` = near-black eyes/mouth. `mono` (white tree) is the default. Order of `colors` is a contract with the relay (hashed like `characters`); append only.

recolor.svg: Elements carry class="bg|ring|tree|tree_dark|tree_light|face"; set fill (and stroke on stroke-based parts) per class. The ring keeps stroke-opacity.

lottie_layers.tree: the animated tree; its fills/strokes are named tree, tree_dark, tree_light, face

recolor.lottie_ios: animationView.setValueProvider(ColorValueProvider(color.lottieColorValue), keypath: AnimationKeypath(keypath: "tree.**.tree_dark.Color")) — one call per role; `**` spans the group nesting. For mono nothing needs setting.
recolor.lottie_web: Before loadAnimation, walk animationData.layers[*].shapes recursively and set `c.k` (RGBA 0-1) on every `fl`/`st` item whose `nm` is the role.
recolor.frame_strips: The white-on-black strips are the `mono` look. For a color, draw the black disc + ring, then the `-tree` strip mapped by grey level: 255 -> tree, 220 -> tree_light, 170 -> tree_dark, 0 -> face (use nearest level for antialiased pixels; keep the pixel alpha).

usage.still: Use `svg` (or the nearest `png`) wherever the avatar is static: lists, headers, notifications.
usage.idle: Loop while the agent has nothing running.
usage.working: Loop while a run is active; switch back to idle when it ends (both loops share frame 0, so cut on a loop boundary).
usage.reply: Play once when a reply lands, then return to idle. It starts and ends on the idle pose.
usage.frame_strips: Frame k of a strip is the square at x = k * size. Advance at `fps`; loop idle/working, play reply once. The widest strip (rail@2x, 90 frames) is 12960 px wide.
usage.tree_strips: `frames[state].tree` = grey-level strips at 56 (`2x`) and 72 (`rail`) px of the tree alone on transparent. Draw the black disc + ring, then map levels to the color's hues. See `recolor.levels`.
usage.color: Per-agent color = one entry of `colors`; default `mono`. Apply the same entry to the still, the Lotties and the strips.
usage.pick: Default avatar for a project = characters[fnv1a64(project_id) % characters.length].
